messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Stakeholder Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Hetherington,

Green Executives' focus on senior leadership within the energy transition and low-carbon economy makes this a relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans ESG and social performance, government and regulatory relations, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, with direct exposure to large-scale renewable-energy, battery-storage and climate-resilience initiatives.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where energy transition strategy, institutional relationships, sustainability performance and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for broader global mandates.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for relevant current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
